notes.title: Game over 2015
notes.content:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-18-44-34.jpg?w=660[/img]

Hi all!

Last week end we were at the [url=https://www.facebook.com/gameovermilano]Game Over 2015[/url] (Milan) and it was quite fun.
We had many great gamers at our location, knows nice persons that were interested in the flair and some other devs.
Some pics, take a look:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-18-44-29.jpg?w=300[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-13-19-16.jpg?w=300[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-19-16-08.jpg?w=300[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-14-49-16.jpg?w=300[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-15-48-26.jpg?w=300[/img]

and here's our youngest champion that made it to level 2: [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/2015-09-19-15-10-02.jpg?w=660[/img]

He didn't even read texts, just follow his instinct ;) AMAZING.
We also gave away some cards:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb03dart.png?w=200[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardhope12.png?w=200[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb01ighel.png?w=200[/img] 
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/cardsynb02dummy.png?w=200[/img]

After the fair we spoke a lot about how the people has played the game and the challenge of the first sector.
So we decided to add a camera move on the first use of the activator to be sure everyone understand what to do, a bit more.

In current version we have other fixes:
[list]
	[*]click on the options highest border doesn't close anymore the options[/*]
	[*]better cut scene on first water colour change, without the problem of pressing the action button and change SynBs at the same time[/*]
	[*]better shader on taken d-Disks[/*]
	[*]first enemies in Sector-01 give more ammo when killed, so no more risk to be without ammo on Sector-02[/*]
	[*]the kebre is easy to kill on Sector- on level easy and normal, with longer scream animation and less energy[/*]
[/list]
You can play right now with all that stuff right now.
With the localization we are on SP, FR and DE, it will take more time but it's coming out.

That's all for the news, take care and have fun until next week!

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Finally THE END+Arenas!
notes.content:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_taken01.gif?w=660[/img]

[h1]DONE! The game is finally complete![/h1]

[b]Tomorrow[/b] we will upload a new version on STEAM! The game has soooo many changes that it will force new save-games (will do it automatically), old ones are now obsolete.
This version has also a lot of fixes, new hints, new rooms and more cut scenes plus a complete new feature which is a new [b]MAP SYSTEM, [/b]related to the collectable-items. You can see on the map where your current SynB and the other SynBs are at any time and see also other informations about the sector.

Take a look:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_map01.jpg?w=660[/img]

We have also complete the IT localization and all the arenas are ALL DONE and READY to play - you just need to find out how unlock them :P
The game modes for the arena mode are still 3 and for each one there are 3 different sectors with a different weapons asset - for a total of 9 different arenas.
Some pics:

[b][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip06.jpg?w=660[/img][/b][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_virusarena.jpg?w=660[/img][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip07.jpg?w=660[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arena3wip01.jpg?w=660[/img] [img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip04.jpg?w=660[/img] The loading time for any arena was also reduced drastically - you will see. ;)

That's all, hope you are happy for the news and we hope also you will play and enjoy and then spread the word!
For any feedback or problem remember to write on the official game HUB!

Thanks a lot, have a great week end and take care!

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: The end is near
notes.content:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_collisionkebre2.jpg?w=660[/img]

Isn't it a nice day? Hi all!
The end is near! :P

Wednesday we finally added all the PCs, with the story/gameplay info, to Sector-10 so [b]it is 100% DONE[/b]. What does this mean? 
It means that the
 [h1]MAIN GAME MODE is COMPLETE. HELL YEAH, dammit![/h1]

So what are we doing now? Of course drinking champagne and watching the sunset... ah, sooooo coool and relaxing.
...sadly not. :P

We are on lot of things because we want to release the game asap, so let's make a list of what's going on:
[list]
	[*]We are completing the [b]IT localization[/b], it's taking a lot of time, more then expected sadly... then we will move on with other languages, at least that's the plan. Alessio fixed all the bugs of the editor and added some features for knowing which sentence was changed and a better backup system.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_editorlangnew.jpg?w=660[/img]
[list]
	[*]With the arenas, we have right now [b]3 new[/b] and playable but [b]for the week end[/b] I think we will have ALL ready. We have added new names (that give an idea of what's going on..) and changed the weapons list and specs, for making them great experience, let's hope you will love them. We reduced the map size, so you can see more icons on screen and planing your moves .[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip01.jpg?w=660[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip02.jpg?w=660[/img] 

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_arenawip03.jpg?w=660[/img]
[list]
	[*]On the [b]ALTERED SIGNAL[/b] arenas we recalculate the [b]noise[/b] effect, it will start sooner but with less.. noise and become stronger with a better progression. In the previous version it started late and strong and we were not completely satisfied with it .[/*]
	[*]Alessio has changed a bit the [b]hit detection of the Kebre[/b], the first boss... it will change with the difficult level, so if you are a beginner :P maybe (MAYBE..) you will make it to Sector-02. MAYBE :D You can see the areas in the image, the black zones are the parts that you hit with the firing of your weapons (and are of course invisible):[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/09/tbc_collisionkebre.jpg?w=660[/img]
[list]
	[*][b]Throwing bombs[/b] now is a bit faster, it takes less time[/*]
	[*]We have some new in game [b]E-mails from NO-END[/b] that introduce the player a bit more to the gameplay, with a bit of infos about the SynBs and the Activator. We decided it could be a good idea after a friend of mine (from UK) played the game and told us his impressions.[/*]
[/list]
Uff that's all. I think it's time for a new version, what do you think? ;)

Have great time and take care.

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: End of August update
notes.content:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_complete03.jpg?w=611[/img]

Hi people!

Time for a new updates after the usual weekly meeting - this week x2 :P.
Sector-10 is having some minor palette changes on last part and we are thinking where to put the interactive PCs for the story infos. Plus now the rooms have names and it was stress-tested.

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_ui.jpg?w=611[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_piece01.jpg?w=611[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_sec10_piece02.jpg?w=611[/img]

On other things: we added in the hints list a new one for switching between the SynBs, with the mouse wheel, and fixed some texts.
We have changed the position of an info PC in Sector-1, because there were too many in a room and we are adding a new info text that will appear during the first fight with the Kebre - here:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/sec01-pcs.jpg?w=611[/img]

We added another 2 achievements, one for the last Sector and one for the Yellow Ray, just like the blue and the green one.
So right now we have added all the achievements from our list (last Sectors, end game...) + some more, everything is ready and uploaded on STEAM. We just need to finish last stuff and upload a new version and complete the end scene.

Alessio is changing the levels for adding some [b]collectable items[/b] following a list we wrote months ago.

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/tbc_trophy.jpg[/img]

Of course this has also a specific new achievements. Here 3 of the icons:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/achiviconsnew1.jpg[/img]

The idea of the collectable items is also "related" to a new feature of the game you will see soon.
Alessio is working on an exporter/converter for all the languages texts - when it will be ready we will have the possibility to manage all the texts... just to time for making the translation ;)

Go-go-go! ;) Take care,

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Update: intro!
notes.content:
[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_intro.gif?w=660[/img]

Hi again!

We have a new update, just for the week end so you can play happy again with you favorite THE BODY CHANGER ^_^.

First of all, as told, we have finally a [b]intro for the game[/b] with a better introduction to the story, more info about what's going on and how you got involved with the no-end mission.
We used [b]3D cut-scenes[/b] made with game engine plus [b]some 2D gfx[/b] for building fake e-mails. We are pretty sure you will like it. ;)
Of course you need to start a new game for seeing it.

We fixed also other stuff (maybe take a look to  STEAM discussion for more details...) and added [b]more info for some puzzles[/b] here and there. We added also some automatic position change for the camera, for making some things more clear: we are trying to avoid situations where you do some action and you hear a sound but it's not clear what's going on.

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_cameras.jpg?w=660[/img]

Because we thought that using the [b]Dart Shock Beam[/b] could be difficult sometimes we added an animated "[b]crosshair[/b]":

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_dartaiming.jpg?w=660[/img]

Have you seen it in the screenshot from last news? ;) You still need to be precise but at least you have a better idea where you will throw your Shock Beam - here's a super short video that shows how cool the animation is:

https://youtu.be/MoNFq8O8YoU

EHI! We finally have uploaded the [b]cards, wallpapers and the emoticons[/b]! Sadly I found out that I forgot to make 3 wallpapers, so this week-end will be time to finish the job :P

We had also the opportunity the install the game on a [b]Microsoft Surface[/b] (with [b]Windows 8[/b]) and it works perfectly:

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/2015-05-07-22-01-09.jpg?w=660[/img] [url=https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_onsurface.jpg][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_onsurface.jpg?w=660[/img][/url]The resolution of 2160x1440 pixel is quite amazing :D

Ok that's all for today, enjoy the game and tell your friends!
And don't forget to [b]share us your thoughts and comments, together we can make the game even better[/b]!

Take care,

TheShortAndTheTall

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_dartaiming.jpg?w=660[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/2015-05-07-22-01-09.jpg?w=660[/img] [url=https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_onsurface.jpg][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2015/05/tbc_onsurface.jpg?w=660[/img][/url]The resolution of 2160x1440 pixel is quite amazing :D

Ok that's all for today, enjoy the game and tell your friends!
And don't forget to [b]share us your thoughts and comments, together we can make the game even better[/b]!

Take care,

TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: New ALPHA! Survive the 3 new ARENA MODES!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/killthemall_w1000.jpg?w=799[/img][/url]

A new and [b]HUGE [/b]update is finally available with a lot of nice things and a most of all: the [b]3 NEW GAME MODES [/b]are finally available!

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_themodes.png?w=800[/img]

To unlock the menu with the [b]Arena Modes [/b]you need to [b]finish sector 1 [/b](so you will have reached the minimum of combat knowledge). After this you will be able to play with the [b]first area [/b]- we will add [b]more and more areas [/b]in the future alphas.  

Any mode is about [b]fighting [/b]and [b]surviving [/b]but has a [b]unique game mechanic[/b] with a special set of [b]custom weapons[/b], so it's not simple shot-or-die (and use and abuse of the combos for making points) but you need to follow the mission and kill as many as possible enemies (by making combos!). 
Because the [b]Arena Modes [/b]  were born for having great time in fast plays and make more points as possible we will add soon [b]STEAM LEADERBOARDS[/b]. So, train now as much as possible :D

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_killgrott.jpg?w=800[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_killorbekilled.jpg?w=800[/img]

But the update is not only about this, so here is our current development change log: 

[list][*][b]UPDATED HUD[/b] [b]ICONS[/b]: the objects icons are now [b]brighter [/b]with a [b]stronger stroke around [/b]and we fixed also a Z-index "bug" where the icons were drawn BEHIND instead of in front of the selector. 
[/*][*][b]UPDATED HUD[/b] [b]SELECTOR [/b]and [b]TABS[/b]: elements are now all blue with less alpha for better contrast and the selector in particular is completely new, with a nicer and more modern design 
[/*][*][b]DIFFICULTY OPTION [/b]is no more available from the option menu - when you will start a new game you will also choose the difficulty level[/*][*][b]NEW GUI ELEMENTS[/b]: we have made a new group of elements for the in-game pop-ups that we will include asap.[/*][*][b]GAME TEXTS [/b]are now all into an unique file, from menu to game text to story - you know, order is always better ;) [/*][/list][img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_hud.jpg?w=800[/img]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/tbc_weaponsright.jpg?w=662[/img]

Next to come: [b]include Sector 6 [/b]in current story mode, insert the [b]leaderboards [/b]in the 3 new game mode, add the new GUI elements and continue with Sector 7.

So, let's hope you will [b]hear the applause [/b](???) when you will playing the new game modes, have a lot of fun and please comment if you have suggestions or just if you like it.
Please also spread the word and, if you have a [b]Facebook account[/b], why don't you [url=https://www.facebook.com/theshortandthetall][b]follow us[/b][/url]? 

Until next time take care and have a great time,

  TheShortAndTheTall

notes.title: Barrell Rolling to an higher level! v. 0.5.18 is here!
notes.content:
Hi people
TBC is on STEAM since a week and the [b]feedbacks were amazing[/b]!

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/tbc_barrelroll1.jpg?w=600[/img]

Tks so much for the help and the suggestions... [b]we are really listening[/b] to you and trying to make TBC the best game possible.
You sure have seen that we [b]continue to make updates with fixes and new stuff[/b], our toDO list now is really full, believe us ;)

Some comments in particularity made us very proud because more then one player said that [b]TBC is not the typical PC game[/b] and also that the game puzzles [b]make you finally think again[/b]. 
No need to add more words, here. :) (we are touched)

But back to the current version that you can play here on Early Access [b](v. 0.5.18)[/b] which has a [b]lot of improvements on the gameplay side[/b]. 
Here is a little list that summarize, more or less, all the important things BUT let me just quote one in particular.

This one need a special mention because was [b]very requested[/b] and sometimes criticize  - it's a [b]new shortcut for the Barrel roll![/b].
Now it's just: [b]simply press twice right/left button[/b] and you will do a pretty nice Barrel roll, with which you can impress friends, parents, who you want.. :P 
...and avoid big enemies so maybe you will ranting a little less ( maybe! :D ),

Ok, jokes aside, here's the list - [i]directly from the pinned discussion[/i]: 

[list]
[*][b]Text hints on screen while loading[/b] - this should be really helpful for a better game experience
[*][b]New weapon change shortcut[/b]: not only we support the mouse wheel but also the keyboard numbers, as asked from many users
[*][b]New menu shortcut[/b]: click more times the INVENTORY BUTTON for switching between in-game menu tabs
[*][b]Some new INFO DEVICES[/b] in some of the puzzle rooms - so, you won't get stuck ;)
[*][b]Fixed a XBOX360 joypad bug[/b] with the default value
[*]Added [b]mouse scroll[/b] on menus but only over-events on the scrollbar (UI library limitation)
[*][b]Fixed[/b] bug on first water change on Sector-01
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Nexus behavior bug on green dummy during the quest S02
[*][b]Fixed[/b] minor bug on Sector-04 and a hole on Sector-03
[*][b]Removed[/b] health losing during barrel roll
[*][b]Disabled teleporter[/b] if there are enemies around
[*][b]UI overlap fixed[/b] when the chara finds ammo
[*][b]Fixed[/b] some chara switching issue 
[/list]

If you had [b]problems or bugs related to all this stuff, it's time to play TBC again[/b] and maybe [b]write some feedback[/b]. 
5 mins for you can really make the difference for us, as maybe you have seen with all the shortcuts on weapons and controls and the bugs.

That all for today. 
Please if you can and like to [b]support us, spread the word and tell your friend about TBC[/b]!

Have a Great week end.

  TheShortandTheTall

notes.title: 17 hours to EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
Hi people!
Tomorrow is finally release time on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/]EARLY ACCESS for THE BODY CHANGER![/url]

[img]https://theshortandthetall.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/capsule_main3.jpg[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/324390/]DIRECT LINK HERE[/url]

First of all tks to all the players that has helped us to make current version very stable and that has posted comments and suggestions.
TBC has now [b]5 completely sectors/levels[/b] fully playable with all the puzzles and action moments. 
We introduce some new things with the last updates, after reading what players has to say:

 [list]
    [*] [b]Text hints on screen while loading[/b] - this should be really helpful for a better game experience
    [*] [b]New weapon change shortcut[/b]: not only we support the mouse wheel but also the keyboard numbers, as asked from many users
    [*] [b]New menu shortcut[/b]: click more times the INVENTORY BUTTON for switching between in-game menu tabs
    [*] Some new [b]INFO DEVICES[/b] in some the puzzle rooms - so, you won't get stuck ;)
[/list] 

During the period on EARLY ACCESS we will continue with the improvements, we will complete and end the [b]other 5 levels[/b], create [b]new achievements[/b], introduce the [b]collectable artifacts[/b] (in all the levels) for increasing the replay value and make it more satisfying.
We would like to end and complete the final game at the [b]beginning of 2015[/b], let's say [b]Febrary[/b].

Also [b]the cards are coming[/b], sadly I'm late on this even if 3 are done and also a lot [b]emoticons are complete[/b] (we just need to choose which one to use).

Ok, that's all for today. :)
Have fun with the game and please spread the word and tell your friends!

  TheShortAndTheTall
